# Support

Thank you for using AgentDNA! Here's how to get help.

## 📚 Documentation

First, check our documentation:

- **[README.md](../README.md)** - Quick start and architecture
- **[STATUS.md](../STATUS.md)** - Current capabilities and limitations
- **[PRODUCTION_READINESS.md](../PRODUCTION_READINESS.md)** - Production blockers
- **[TESTING.md](../TESTING.md)** - Test coverage details
- **[docs/architecture.md](../docs/architecture.md)** - System design
- **[docs/wireframe.md](../docs/wireframe.md)** - UI specifications

## 🐛 Found a Bug?

1. Check [existing issues](https://github.com/amg555/Agentdna/issues) first
2. If it's new, [open a bug report](https://github.com/amg555/Agentdna/issues/new?template=bug_report.md)
3. Include:
   - Operating system and Python version
   - Steps to reproduce
   - Expected vs actual behavior
   - Relevant logs (but **NO secrets or personal data**)

## 💡 Have a Feature Idea?

1. Check [existing issues](https://github.com/amg555/Agentdna/issues) first
2. [Open a feature request](https://github.com/amg555/Agentdna/issues/new?template=feature_request.md)
3. Explain:
   - What problem it solves
   - How you envision it working
   - Privacy considerations

## 🔒 Security Issue?

**DO NOT** open a public issue for security vulnerabilities.

See [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md) for responsible disclosure process.

## 💬 Questions and Discussion

- **General questions**: Open a [GitHub Discussion](https://github.com/amg555/Agentdna/discussions)
- **Contributing questions**: See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
- **Code of Conduct**: See [CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md](../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)

## 🤝 Want to Contribute?

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for:
- Development setup
- Coding standards
- Pull request process
- Good first issues

## ⚠️ Important Notes

**AgentDNA is currently in alpha:**
- Not production ready
- Safe for local testing only
- Missing database encryption and desktop packaging
- See [PRODUCTION_READINESS.md](../PRODUCTION_READINESS.md) for details

**Privacy:**
- Never share API keys, secrets, or personal data in issues
- Review logs before pasting (use `grep -v` to remove sensitive data)
- When reporting issues with privacy features, use generic examples

## 🌟 Support the Project

If you find AgentDNA useful:
- ⭐ Star the repository
- 🐛 Report bugs
- 💡 Suggest features
- 🤝 Contribute code or documentation
- 📢 Share with others who care about privacy-first automation

Thank you for being part of the AgentDNA community!
